manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
description:
Activate Bounding Krasis using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Bounding Krasis to Yenna and causing Bounding Krasis to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Bounding Krasis.
When the Bounding Krasis token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bounding Krasis token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
